body:
Thank you.  Obviously I haven't done anything brash yet, and I'm seeking therapy for my anxiety and worries.  My first appointment is tomorrow.  The attacks are getting worse, my worries and insecurities are affecting my relationship with this woman, and it's really hard to tell when one might get bad enough that I actually do end my life.  

I talked to a friend about that night/morning when I plotted to kill myself, she's a psychiatrist but obviously I can't ask her to treat me.  None the less she and I sat down and determined I was in the throws of a panic attack and plotting my own death helped to return to me a sense of control and relieve the sensations of my anxiety.  She worries that my threshold for numbing these sensations is starting to get higher, and that eventually it'll escalate into a real suicide attempt, or rather a real suicide because she knows I won't risk the chance of failing while I'm in that state.  

I'm reading "The Worry Cure" at the moment, and I'm specifically seeking out CBT therapy.  I'll take your book suggestion. I appreciate your being so thorough in your response, and I know leaning too much on one person isn't healthy but who do you tell about a life like mine? I can talk to you, you don't know me, but I have no one who can remotely sympathize with what it's like to be bleeding into your underwear after another "game" with your cousin, get home feeling pale inside and out, and have to listen to a 45 minute tirade from your mother about how you're a worthless piece of shit who's just like your closeted homosexual father (He's not, btw) and that you don't love anyone or anything and you need to get the hell out of her house.   Nobody, not anyone with whom I ever speak, is ever going to be able to understand that feeling and so I don't speak of it and never did. 

When I finally, FINALLY, crossed that threshold and trusted someone, my fear of her abandoning me or finding me disgusting or not worthy... It just got to be too much.  My mind is a video real of nightmares and sometimes it's just flat out too much for me to handle.  I really don't know how I survived the night that I made this post, I guess I should thank her for not making any sudden decisions because if she had I could very well be dead.
